rationale: Price gapped down ~10% and has been grinding upward through the session, now sitting at 84% of today's range near the day's high of $28.69 — a poor risk/reward entry for either direction. A long here risks a reversal from the high with limited upside before resistance, while a short into a recovering bounce with strong relative volume (2.91x) and upward momentum in the last several candles carries equal risk. The spread and ATR are manageable, but the position in range and proximity to the session high make the setup asymmetrically unfavorable at this moment.
